title: ManiaPlanet (Trackmania²)
provenance: Reported by LotharieSlayer (upstream#247, 2026-09-28), the Trackmania² games through ManiaPlanet, Apple M1 Pro, macOS 27.0, KLYC-Box 0.9.39, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r11, DXMT, sync none, recipes vcrun2022, controller-sdl, fakejapanese, corefonts and battle-net (DXMT_ALLOW_CROSS_PROCESS_SWAPCHAIN=1 set in the environment), rated 4 of 5 after 5 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: ManiaPlanet is Nadeo's platform that runs the Trackmania² games (Canyon, Stadium, Valley and Lagoon, each sold on Steam). Reported playable on DXMT on an M1 Pro with the default engine r11 after a five-minute session. The report does not say which title or which store. Nothing was measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: The interface looks stretched on screens that are not 16:9, and the resolution is only right in fullscreen (reported).
knownIssues.fix: play in fullscreen, per the reporter.
